signal: Minitab is rolling out enhanced AI capabilities in its Statistical Software to automate visualizations and analysis for users.

email.body1:
Phil, saw Minitab is pushing enhanced AI into your Statistical Software to automate analysis and visualizations.

New capabilities like that usually open more in-market accounts than a regional team can cover before reps reach them all, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Minitab off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your region's number
email.body2:
Phil, quick follow-up for Minitab.

As the AI story expands the buyer base, target expectations on your region usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Phil, last bit of proof for Minitab.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Phil, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority for the region this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and rolling out new AI capabilities keeps a team plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Minitab either way.
